asA: chain author or stage-keeper on a product that used the 0.36.x verified backstop
iWant: backstop.json, backstop adopt and --allow-unverified to refuse or warn with the new backstop named
soThat: no runbook keeps waiting on verified to start a Build
title: A chain author upgrading from 0.36.x sees the verified backstop's pieces retire with their replacement named

acceptanceCriteria.description: [edge] Given a fixture tree carrying rcf/define/backstop.json with fromBuildOrder 1 and a complete-not-verified FBS above it, and a green base-suite record, rcf build bundle --next --base-suite <file> exits 0, emits the bundle, and stderr carries exactly one line "[warn] backstop: rcf/define/backstop.json is retired in 0.37.0 and ignored; the backstop is the base suite".

[failure] When rcf build backstop adopt --from FBS-001 runs, it exits 2 with stderr "[error] usage backstop adopt is retired in 0.37.0; the backstop is the base suite (rcf build base-suite)" and writes no file.

[failure] When rcf build bundle --next --allow-unverified "hotfix" --base-suite <file> runs, it exits 2 with stderr "[error] usage --allow-unverified is retired in 0.37.0; no override lets a Build start on a red base" and emits no bundle.
[must-not] No 0.37.0 command writes or reads backstop.overrides: after any run of this story's fixtures, an existing rcf/define/backstop.json is byte-identical and no new one is created.
